shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd
git status --short --branch
rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '.lore/test-commands.yml' -g 'src/types/messages.ts' -g 'src/index.ts' -g '*test*' | sed -n '1,240p'
sed -n '1,240p' package.json
sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml
sed -n '1,260p' src/types/messages.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/index.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md
sed -n '1,220p' src/infrastructure/stores/sessionStoreListSignature.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/index.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/types/sessionStore.ts
rg -n \"specs/.*#|validated by\" src/*.test.ts src/infrastructure/stores/*.test.ts specs | sed -n '1,160p'
rg --files scripts | rg 'reanchor' || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
sed -n '100,180p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
sed -n '1,160p' jest.config.js"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#[0-9]+|@spec|spec:\" src scripts | sed -n '1,160p'
node scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,40p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md .lore/dod.md
node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs
 timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts --runInBand
git diff --check
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"answers list_sessions|answers an empty session_list|accepts a bare list_sessions\" src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
nl -ba src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts | sed -n '1,20p'
git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md .lore/dod.md
node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts --runInBand
git diff --check
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --stat
git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts
git commit -m "feat(transport): validate session list frames"
git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main
git merge --no-edit origin/main
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD@{1} HEAD; then git push origin HEAD; fi
git status --short --branch'
